column1: # test_skip_allowlist.tsv — the tests that MAY skip in a run that a pre-push verdict record certifies
# (Q-1065; read by scripts/prepush_verdict_record.sh write from HEAD's tree). Each data line is five
# TAB-separated fields: Class.method, skip|xfail, a substring the skip reason must contain, the Q-row
# that justifies it, and where the test does run. The run's skips must EQUAL this list: an unlisted
# skip, a reason without its substring, or a listed test that ran all make LEG_TESTS=FAIL. Each
# entry's method in tests.py carries `# SKIP-ALLOWLIST <Q-row>`, and the script pins the number of
# entries (SKIP_ALLOWLIST_SKIPS / SKIP_ALLOWLIST_XFAILS), so adding a line also takes those two edits.
# Tests that need lake (the Lean 4 toolchain) are NOT listed: they run where the record is produced.
